summary: Signal Stage is a walkable 3D motion-graphics stage with a synchronized seeded cinematic on the measured 160-bpm, 198-second track. A shared director clock/deck drives shader-built stage assemblies, ten camera-riding celestial beings, the camera and full-screen look; player input and HUD operate the shared roll.
places: places/main/config.yaml (main, 3D) - black void, spawn near (0, 0.1, 16), gravity, and place-wide scripts/look-trip.js atmosphere look.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - #director and the field/eye/serpents stage assemblies; eye portal at (0,15,-34), field at origin.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene and x0z-3.scene - sun-eye, tunnel along -Z, chamber assembly and tunnel-knot at the far end.
places/main/cells/x0y2z0.scene - vision-sun-father assembly high above the field (y=300).
places/main/cells/x0y3z0.scene and x0y4z0.scene - vision-moon-mother (y=420) and vision-contour-oracle (y=500).
places/main/cells/x0y6z0.scene and x0y7z0.scene - vision-thunderbird (y=820) and vision-world-tree (y=920).
places/main/cells/x0y8z0.scene and x0y9z0.scene - vision-giving-hands (y=1020), vision-star-jelly (y=1120), and vision-star-child (y=1220); the latter two each have being/ring/veil layers.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer services, player/camera templates, movement and cine actions, arrival, lighting, HUD and nametag.
templates/player.js#player composes humanoid-locomotion.js with scripts/player.js; templates/camera.js#camera runs scripts/camera.js.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - scripts/stage.js synchronizes track and pushes roll/deal parameters.
scripts/ui.js - viewer-local ROLL/CUT controls and cinematic status HUD.
places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look - installs scripts/look-trip.js as full-screen post-processing look.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - CPU score clock, section lookup and seeded camera path/moves; used by player, camera, HUD and stage.
scripts/lib/deck.js - deterministic per-seed scene-deck deal and track-to-scene-time mapping; used by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/visions.js - ten-being registry, seeded slot deal, vision timing/shots and measured-energy lookup; used by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml and shots.yml - musical sections, layers, lens, scene-deck choices and authored camera keys; energy.yml holds measured track data and vision slots.
scripts/lib/trip.js - shared shader clocks, kick runs, seeded palette/random choices, scene/layer visibility, lens bending and vision visibility/clocks.
scripts/field-lib.js, eye-lib.js, tunnel-lib.js, chamber-lib.js and chamber-fx.js - family-specific spatial, timing and shader helpers.
scripts/sun-lib.js - sun-eye shader helpers; scripts/serpents-data.js and serpents-curve.js - shared serpent records, spine and frame math.
notableExports: scripts/player.js exports onInput, update; scripts/camera.js exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/stage.js exports update; scripts/look-trip.js exports look; scripts/ui.js exports default.
scripts/lib/cine.js exports CINE, cineTime, sectionAt, rollRnd, cameraAt, beatEnv; scripts/lib/deck.js exports dealDeck, sceneTime.

scripts/lib/visions.js exports BEINGS, dealVisions, visionAt, visionShot, energyAt; scripts/lib/trip.js exports KICK_RUNS, SEC, BPS, tripClock, win, pal, stripes, HUE, shown, lens, bendUv, visionShown.
scripts/tunnel-core.js, tunnel-gates.js and tunnel-ribs.js export material; scripts/tunnel-lib.js exports Z0, FEET, BOUNDS, tun, inside, camDepth, v3, BLUE, base, hot, GRAPH, mirAng.
Field, eye, serpent, tunnel, chamber, sun and vision geometry scripts export geometry/collider where defined; paired shader scripts export material (field-mandala.js also exports material).
ownership: scripts/player.js - local movement intent/velocity and shared world.state.cine = {start, by, seed} or null from cine input.
scripts/stage.js on #director - shared audio session; trip materials/look receive t0/on/seed/kick and scene-deal params, look receives v0/v1, and vision-tagged materials receive vw0/vw1.
scripts/stage.js - per-being visibility and feetPosition: selected dealt being attaches to camera at depth; all others return to their elevated home positions.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - viewer-local camera pose/FOV and seeded authored shot path/move.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - avatar gait/sit state; scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - viewer-local presentation only.
places/main/config.yaml owns atmosphere, spawn, gravity, terrain mode and look params; world.config.yaml owns world services, inputs and templates.
flows: P/cine action or HUD sendAction('cine') → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine={start: now+300ms, by, seed} or null.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → viewer-local ROLL/CUT and rolling progress/section label.
world.state.cine + score track → #director scripts/stage.js → shared audio at c.start; director stops audio and clears/renews ended cine.
stage.js → trip-tagged materials/look params: t0, on, seed, kick bounds k0/k1 and dealt scene mappings ds0..ds3/dr0..dr3; look also gets current vision slot v0/v1.
stage.js + visions.js → objects tagged vision-<id> receive vw0/vw1 slot seconds or -1/-1 and are moved/hidden as the current being or returned home.
energy.yml → trip.js KICK_RUNS and visions.js measured vision slots → director supplies kick runs and seeded vision-slot assignment.
score.yml + deck.js → seeded scene per drop stretch → cine.js scene clock/cameraAt and trip.js shader scene clock use the same assigned source section/rate.
cine.js cameraAt → scripts/camera.js viewer camera; dealt beings join the camera view at depth rather than cutting the camera away to a separate vision shot.
score.yml + trip.js tripClock/shown/lens/mask helpers → field, eye, serpents, tunnel, chamber, vision assemblies and look-trip shader timing and cutouts.
scripts/sun-lib.js → sun-eye disc/drips/halo shaders; tunnel-geo.js kind-selected geometry → tunnel wall/core/dust/gates/ribs and knot layers.
places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look params → scripts/look-trip.js; world.config.yaml movement actions → scripts/player.js velocity, while templates/player.js also runs avatar locomotion.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/field-* - mandala, stalks, orbs and glyph/cartouche field layers share field-lib.js placement/timing while geometry and materials vary motifs.
scripts/eye-* - iris, pupil, rays, lids, beads and knot make the portal; eye-lib.js shares eye math and iris geometry is reused for pupil with different parameters.
scripts/serpents-* - co-located layers build striped/scaled bodies, arches, beads, cones, knots, rose beads and totem; serpents-lib.js/serpents-curve.js share appearance and spine/frame calculations.
scripts/tunnel-* - wall, core, dust, gates, ribs and knot share tunnel geometry kinds and tunnel-lib.js spatial/color helpers; materials vary motif and seeded palette.
scripts/chamber-* - room, circuit, hands, hex, Lissajous, solids and bilateral mask share chamber shader helpers and scored cutouts.
scripts/sun-disc.js, sun-drips.js and sun-halo.js - sun-eye layers share sun-lib.js but vary disc, hanging-drip and depth-halo imagery.

scripts/vision-*-geo.js and vision-*-mat.js - ten beings share trip/vision shader timing and staged visibility; multi-layer assemblies vary geometry/material motif, with star-jelly and star-child each using one shader/material across being, ring and veil layers.

scripts/look-trip.js and scripts/lib/trip.js - full-screen post-processing and scene shaders share score clock, seeded scene deal, visibility and lens math; templates/player.js composes gait with input/movement.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine is the synchronized start/cut source; starts are scheduled 300 ms ahead. cine.js uses milliseconds for start/ctx.now() and seconds for score/shot keys.

stage.js converts c.start to shader t0 seconds modulo 3600 and repeats parameter pushes over several ticks so late-built materials receive the roll; tagged trip materials need t0/on/seed and kick bounds k0/k1.

Trip shaders normally use dealt scene time; vision-tagged materials with vw0 switch to real track seconds. A dealt being enters before its drop and remains briefly beyond it; its matching vision-<id> tags let stage.js stage all of its layers together.

Vision assemblies are housed above the field in +Y but the selected being is camera-attached at 74 m; layer IDs ending -ring and -veil get home-Z offsets (-12/+10) that stage.js subtracts from attachment depth.

Score is 198 seconds at 160 bpm, first beat 0.35 s; idle shaders free-run the duration loop. Units are metres, +Y up, vision canvases face +Z; main composition runs from field/eye through tunnel to chamber on -Z.
Layer visibility is shader cutout via shown()/masks, not a fade to black; vision materials use visionShown/visionU and stage.js visibility, so scene objects must retain matching vision-<id> tags.
